2608.09432.title: ZetaGPT: A Reference Implementation of Positional--Encoding--Free State--Space--Attention Language Models
2608.09432.paper_summary: Transformer-based language models rely on self-attention, whose computation is permutation-equivariant and therefore lacks an intrinsic mechanism for representing token order. Existing architectures address this limitation by explicitly incorporating positional information through learned positional embeddings or hand-crafted positional encodings, such as rotary positional encoding (RoPE), treating positional information as an architecturally acquired capability rather than an inherent property of the model. Motivated by the pursuit of positional-encoding-free architectures, this work explores a language model architecture that integrates causal state-space equations to implicitly encode positional information before attention computation. Specifically, each model block applies a causal state-space equation before self-attention, allowing recurrent state dynamics to encode sequential information into token representations. Consequently, subsequent attention layers operate on position-aware representations without requiring explicit positional encodings while retaining the expressive modeling capacity of self-attention. We present \textsc{ZetaGPT}, a compact hybrid language model designed for research, rapid prototyping, algorithm verification, and educational applications. In addition to the proposed architecture, \textsc{ZetaGPT} provides a fully open-source, end-to-end training pipeline encompassing dataset construction, tokenizer training, pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning via pure reinforcement learning. To the best of our knowledge, \textsc{ZetaGPT} is the first open-source small language model without explicit positional encoding and establishes a compact, reproducible reference implementation for the development and empirical study of positional-encoding-free language models.
2608.09432.paper_summary_zh: 基於Transformer的語言模型依賴於自注意力，其計算是置換等變的，因此缺乏表示標記順序的內在機制。現有架構通過學習的位置信息嵌入或手工製作的位置信息編碼（如旋轉位置編碼（RoPE））明確地納入位置信息，將位置信息視為一種架構獲得的能力，而不是模型的固有特性。受到追求無位置編碼架構的啟發，本研究探索了一種語言模型架構，該架構整合了因果狀態空間方程，以在自注意力計算之前隱式編碼位置信息。具體而言，每個模型塊在自注意力之前應用因果狀態空間方程，允許遞歸狀態動態將序列信息編碼到標記表示中。因此，後續的注意力層在不需要明確位置編碼的情況下對位置感知表示進行操作，同時保留自注意力的表達建模能力。我們提出了 \textsc{ZetaGPT}，這是一個為研究、快速原型設計、算法驗證和教育應用而設計的緊湊混合語言模型。除了所提出的架構外，\textsc{ZetaGPT} 還提供了一個完全開源的端到端訓練管道，涵蓋數據集構建、標記器訓練、預訓練、監督微調、來自人類反饋的強化學習（RLHF）以及通過純強化學習進行的思維鏈（CoT）推理。據我們所知，\textsc{ZetaGPT} 是第一個沒有明確位置編碼的開源小型語言模型，並為無位置編碼語言模型的開發和實證研究建立了一個緊湊、可重現的參考實現。
